label: Organisicator
author: wobble
description: Work inside organisicator-managed projects: pick a shot, open and save its comps, send Writes to its render folder, read its plates, and load footage from organisicator's database (a shot's own and the footage linked to it) instead of the file browser. The wobble twin of organisicator's Blender add-on.

commands.label: load from project…
commands.tip: a new Load with footage picked from organisicator's database

commands.label: save comp to shot
commands.tip: save the comp in the picked shot's comp folder, Writes pointed at its renders

commands.label: renders to shot
commands.tip: point every Write at the shot's render folder

commands.label: add plates
commands.tip: a Load for each sequence in the shot's plates folder

pickers.label: from project…
pickers.tip: pick footage from organisicator's database: the project's folders (only those with footage), a shot's own and its linked footage

rows.label: folders with footage (pick to open, again to fold)
